caption: The drawing is in grayscale and features a large, centrally placed jug or pitcher with a rounded body, a wide spout on the left, and an ornate handle with a curved structure on the right. The pitcher has subtle horizontal lines around its widest part and near the base, indicating decorative bands or contours. The vessel stands on a short, circular foot. The entire pitcher is shaded to convey a three-dimensional effect, with darker shading on the left side and under the handle. Beneath the main drawing, there are five smaller rectangular boxes aligned horizontally, each containing a separate simple line drawing: the first shows a heart shape; the second, a small outline of the jug with a heart at its center; the third presents a line drawing of the handle’s shape; the fourth depicts an elongated oval or a side profile of the handle; and the fifth box is empty, aside from the faint lines of the rectangle. All lines are done in pencil or a similarly fine medium, on a light, slightly yellowed background. The name "S. LISWOOD" appears in the lower right corner.
title: Pewter Pitcher
